commonInstruction: Read the public fixture, implement one first candidate, run the recorded public test command once, and stop. Choose your own agent topology.

vanilla.treatmentInstruction: Use the public documents directly. Do not use FB or graph guidance.

broadFb.treatmentInstruction: Use FB coordination. Treat every public document as broad context and reconcile current rules against history. Do not use a graph packet.

preventiveGraphFb.treatmentInstruction: Use FB coordination and the compiled preventive graph packet. Treat the packet as a routing summary of the public documents, not extra product facts.

graphPacket.objective: Prepare one first-pass candidate and stop at Ready to ship.
decisions: Highest revision wins within a duplicate scope.
missingEvidence: Block bugs missing reproduction or observable evidence.
riskTriggers: Privacy, authentication, payment, migration, provider-state, destructive, and release work require safety approval.
Every blocker needs reason, owner, and next action.
acceptance: Status is Ready to ship and deployment is not authorized.
All three design checks are true.
Keep HTTPS review links only and require no routine user QA.
